Application Data.NAME: Smith's Camera & Photo Supply
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith's Camera & Photo Supply specializes in providing a wide range of photographic equipment, accessories, and supplies for both amateur and professional photographers. Our operations include retail sales of cameras, lenses, lighting equipment, and various accessories, as well as providing expert advice and consultation services to help customers select the right products for their needs. We maintain a well-organized retail space with a focus on customer service, ensuring that our clients have a positive shopping experience. Additionally, we offer occasional workshops and events focused on photography techniques and equipment usage, all while ensuring compliance with safety and security measures, such as having a monitored alarm system in place.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our retail location resulting in a loss of inventory valued at $2,500. The stolen items included cameras and accessories. The incident was reported to the local authorities, and the status is currently under police investigation.
